name: Scrapling
description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
one_liner: A toolkit that fetches web pages — even ones that fight back with JavaScript and bot-detection — and hands you clean, structured data instead of raw HTML.
buyer: A small e-commerce seller or market-research operator who needs daily prices, stock levels, or listings pulled from competitor websites without hiring a scraping engineer.
business_use_cases: A reseller tracks competitor prices across hundreds of product pages every night and auto-adjusts their own store's pricing.
A recruiting agency scrapes job boards and company career pages to build a lead list of companies hiring for roles they can staff.
A local real-estate investor scrapes listing sites daily to catch new price drops before other buyers see them.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted scrape-as-a-service API for one vertical (e.g. e-commerce price tracking), billed by request volume.
A done-for-you scraping setup and maintenance retainer for small businesses who can't maintain their own scrapers.

steal_this: Build a single-purpose price-tracking bot for one niche (sneaker resale, grocery prices, flight fares) and sell access to the daily report.
